scripts.text:
[Ticket Helper]
Welcome to the
Monster Race Arena.
If you'd like to participate
in the ^3131FFSingle Monster Race^000000,
then please select 1 out of
the 6 monsters from the list.
scripts.translation:
[票務助手]
歡迎來到魔物賽跑競技場。
想參加^3131FF單魔物賽跑^000000的話，請從列表中的6只魔物裡選出1只。

scripts.text:
[Ticket Helper]
Wait, wait...
I can't give you
anything right now.
You're carrying way
too many things...
scripts.translation:
[票務助手]
等等，等等...
你帶的東西太多了，我現在沒法再給你任何東西...

scripts.text: Monster Status
scripts.translation: 魔物狀態

scripts.text: Monster 2

scripts.text:
[Ticket Helper]
You have selected
Monster ^FF0000{0}^000000 for the
Single Monster Race.
The start of the race
will be announced soon,
so please wait. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[票務助手]
你已選擇^FF0000{0}^000000號魔物參加單魔物賽跑。
比賽開始時會發布通知，請稍等。
謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Ticket Helper]
You've chosen Monster {0}?
Alright then, please wait
until the start of the race is
announced. If the monster you
picked wins, then please use this ticket to redeem your prize.
scripts.translation:
[票務助手]
你選的是{0}號魔物，對吧？
好的，請等候比賽開始的通知。
如果你選的魔物獲勝，就憑這張票來領獎。

scripts.text:
[Ticket Helper]
I'm sorry, but a Monster
Race is now in progress.
If you'd like to participate, then please wait for the next race.
scripts.translation:
[票務助手]
抱歉，魔物賽跑正在進行中。
想參加的話，請等下一場比賽。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
I'm sorry, but I can't
reward you with any medals
until you make more space
available in your Inventory.
scripts.translation:
[勳章發放員]
抱歉，你得先在物品欄裡騰出些空間，我才能給你發獎牌。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Hello there~
If you've wagered on the
winning monster in a recent
race, then you can exchange
your game ticket here for
some Prize Medals.
scripts.translation:
[勳章發放員]
你好~
如果你押中了剛才那場比賽的獲勝魔物，就可以在這裡憑比賽票兌換神奇的獎牌。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Please remember that you can
only exchange winning Game
Tickets for Prize Medals right
after the race finishes. Prize
Medals may be given to Wayne
in Hugel in exchange for items.
scripts.translation:
[勳章發放員]
記住，只有在比賽剛結束時，才能憑中獎的比賽票兌換神奇的獎牌。
獎牌可以交給毀葛的韋恩，用來兌換物品。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Oh, congratulations, you
have a winning ticket for
a Single Monster Race! So 
would you like to exchange your
Racing Ticket for Prize Medals?
scripts.translation:
[勳章發放員]
哦，恭喜！
你這張票押中了單魔物賽跑的獲勝魔物！
要把賽跑票兌換成神奇的獎牌嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 好的，請兌換

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Um, are you sure? You 
can only exchange a winning
Racing Ticket for Prize Medals
for a short time after the race. If you made a mistake, you
should ask me again quickly.
scripts.translation:
[勳章發放員]
你確定嗎？
中獎的賽跑票只有在比賽結束後的一小段時間內，才能兌換神奇的獎牌。
如果剛才選錯了，就趕緊再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Let me see your ticket...
Oh! Congratulations, you
won! May I have your name?
scripts.translation:
[勳章發放員]
讓我看看你的票...
哦！恭喜，你贏了！
請問你叫什麼名字？

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Ah, {0}.
You can exchange this
ticket for a Prize Medal by
entering your ticket exchange
number now. Your ticket
exchange number is ^FF0000{1}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[勳章發放員]
啊，{0}。
現在輸入兌換號碼，就能憑這張票領取一枚神奇的獎牌。
你的兌換號碼是^FF0000{1}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Oh? You don't want
to exchange your
winning ticket?
scripts.translation:
[勳章發放員]
哦？
你不想兌換這張中獎的票嗎？

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Thank you! You entered
the correct number...
Everything seems to
be in order. Alright!
scripts.translation:
[勳章發放員]
謝謝！
你輸入的號碼正確...
一切都沒問題。
好！

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Now please accept your
Prize Medals! You can
exchange these with
Wayne in Hugel for some
interesting items. Thank you~
scripts.translation:
[勳章發放員]
請收下你的神奇的獎牌！
拿這些獎牌去找毀葛的韋恩，就能兌換一些有趣的物品。
謝謝~

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
I'm sorry, but it seems
that you entered the
incorrect ticket number.
Would you mind coming
back again in a while?
scripts.translation:
[勳章發放員]
抱歉，你輸入的票號好像不對。
請過一會兒再來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
What's this...?
I think there's a problem...
Did you enter your name
incorrectly? Please check
your name, and then try again.
scripts.translation:
[勳章發放員]
怎麼回事...？
好像哪裡出了問題...
你是不是輸錯了名字？
請核對一下名字，再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
You may not have wagered
on the winning monster in
the last race, but I hope that
you get lucky next time~
scripts.translation:
[勳章發放員]
看來你沒押中上一場比賽的獲勝魔物，希望你下次能有好運氣~

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Hello there~
If you've wagered on the
winning monster in a recent
race, then you can exchange
your game ticket here for
some Prize Medals.
scripts.translation:
[勳章發放員]
你好~
如果你押中了剛才那場比賽的獲勝魔物，就可以在這裡憑比賽票兌換神奇的獎牌。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Please remember that you can
only exchange winning Game
Tickets for Prize Medals right
after the race finishes. Prize
Medals may be given to Wayne
in Hugel in exchange for items.
scripts.translation:
[勳章發放員]
記住，只有在比賽剛結束時，才能憑中獎的比賽票兌換神奇的獎牌。
獎牌可以交給毀葛的韋恩，用來兌換物品。

scripts.text:
[Exit Guide]
If you have a winning Racing
Ticket, please make sure that
you redeem it for Prize Medals
now. All Racing Tickets become
void once the next race begins.
scripts.translation:
[出口嚮導]
如果你有中獎的賽跑票，務必現在就兌換成神奇的獎牌。
下一場比賽一開始，所有賽跑票都會失效。

scripts.text:
[Exit Guide]
If you wish to leave
the arena, then I can guide
you outside. Would you like
to leave the arena right now?
scripts.translation:
[出口嚮導]
想離開競技場的話，我可以帶你出去。
你現在要離開嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Exit Guide]
Alright, then.
Just let me know
whenever you're
ready to leave.
scripts.translation:
[出口嚮導]
好的。
準備離開時，隨時告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Exit Guide]
Thank you for
your patronage, and
I hope that you come
visit us again soon~
scripts.translation:
[出口嚮導]
感謝惠顧，希望你很快再來玩~

scripts.text:
[Exit Guide]
In accordance with our
policies, I must take your
Racing Ticket before you leave.
Thank you for your patronage,
and I hope you enjoy your time
here in the Monster Race Arena.
scripts.translation:
[出口嚮導]
按照規定，你離開前，我必須收回你的賽跑票。
感謝惠顧，希望你在魔物賽跑競技場玩得開心。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Welcome to the biggest
attraction in Hugel, the
Monster Race Arena.
How may I help you today?
scripts.translation:
[埃卡爾·艾勒伯德]
歡迎來到毀葛最受歡迎的景點——魔物賽跑競技場。
有什麼我能幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: Monster Race Info
scripts.translation: 魔物賽跑介紹

scripts.text: Enter Monster Race
scripts.translation: 進入賽場

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Monster Races originated from
simple children's games in which
Cute Pets would race against each other. This grew into an adult
pastime that is so popular, we've built a racing arena in Hugel.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡爾·艾勒伯德]
魔物賽跑最初只是孩子們讓寵物互相賽跑的小遊戲，後來逐漸成了大人們的消遣。
這項活動實在太受歡迎，所以我們在毀葛建了這座賽跑競技場。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Our Monster Race Arena hosts
two types of monster races. First, we have the Single Monster Race,
in which those that wagered on the 1st place monster are rewarded.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡爾·艾勒伯德]
我們這裡有兩種魔物賽跑。
第一種是單魔物賽跑，押中冠軍魔物就能獲得獎勵。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Then, we have the Dual Monster
Race in which the house odds and rewards are greater than in Single
Monster Races: you must wager on 2 monsters, and they must place in
1st and 2nd for you to win.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡爾·艾勒伯德]
另一種是雙魔物賽跑，賠率和獎勵都比單魔物賽跑高。
你要押兩隻魔物，只有它們包攬第一、第二名，你才能贏。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Although a small entrance
fee is required, we only use
the money to give rewards to
participants and maintain this
arena. Therefore, we're not
profiting from this enterprise.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡爾·艾勒伯德]
雖然我們收取少量入場費，但這些錢只用於發放獎勵和維護競技場。
所以，我們並不靠這項活動賺錢。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Also, we prohibit others
from making personal bets
and wagers, using items and
zeny, based on the outcomes
of these races. That kind of
gambling is illegal here...
scripts.translation:
[埃卡爾·艾勒伯德]
另外，我們禁止玩家根據比賽結果，用物品或Zeny私下下注。
這種賭博在這裡是違法的...

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Once you enter the Race Arena, you will receive a Racing Ticket.
Keep in mind that winning Racing Tickets can only be exchanged for
Prize Medals during a 5 minute window after the end of the race.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡爾·艾勒伯德]
進入賽場後，你會拿到一張賽跑票。
記住，中獎的賽跑票只能在比賽結束後的5分鐘內兌換神奇的獎牌。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
The entrance fee for all races
in the Monster Race Arena is
2,000 zeny. If you'd like to wager on a Dual Monster Race, then
please ask my brother Erenes,
and he will help you.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡爾·艾勒伯德]
這裡所有魔物賽跑的入場費都是2,000 Zeny。
想參加雙魔物賽跑，就找我的兄弟艾雷內斯，他會幫你。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Otherwise, I'll help get you
started if you're interested
in a Single Monster Race.
Would you like wager on
a Single Monster Race?
scripts.translation:
[埃卡爾·艾勒伯德]
如果你想參加單魔物賽跑，我可以幫你安排。
要參加單魔物賽跑嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 好的，請安排

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Very well. I hope that
you enjoy your time here
in the Monster Race Arena~
scripts.translation:
[埃卡爾·艾勒伯德]
好的，希望你在魔物賽跑競技場玩得盡興~

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Oh, wow. You're carrying
an awful lot of stuff... Yeah,
you better put some of it away
in Kafra Storage or something.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡爾·艾勒伯德]
哇，你帶的東西可真多...
最好先把一些東西存到卡普拉倉庫之類的地方。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough
money to pay the
2,000 zeny entrance fee.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡爾·艾勒伯德]
抱歉，你的錢不夠支付2,000 Zeny的入場費。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Hm? What are you doing
with an expired Racing Ticket?
Well, I better get rid of it for you before it can get mixed up
with your new Racing Ticket.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡爾·艾勒伯德]
嗯？
你怎麼還留著過期的賽跑票？
我幫你處理掉吧，免得和新票弄混了。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough
money to pay the
2,000 zeny entrance fee.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡爾·艾勒伯德]
抱歉，你的錢不夠支付2,000 Zeny的入場費。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Alright, I think you
should be all set. I hope
that you enjoy the race~
Let me guide you inside
the Monster Race Arena now.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡爾·艾勒伯德]
好，一切都準備好了。
希望你看比賽看得開心~
現在我帶你進入魔物賽跑競技場。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Thanks, I hope that
you enjoy this race.
Let me guide you now
to the Monster Race Arena.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡爾·艾勒伯德]
謝謝，希望你看比賽看得開心。
現在我帶你進入魔物賽跑競技場。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
We're still finishing our
preparations for the next
Single Monster Race, so
we ask that you please
wait a little while longer...
scripts.translation:
[埃卡爾·艾勒伯德]
下一場單魔物賽跑還在做最後的準備，請再稍等一會兒...

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Right now, a Monster Race
is in progress. It's too late to place a wager, but if you'd like
to watch, the fee is 500 zeny
for spectators. Would you like to enter the Monster Race Arena?
scripts.translation:
[埃卡爾·艾勒伯德]
魔物賽跑正在進行，現在已經不能下注了。
不過，你可以花500 Zeny入場觀賽。
要進入魔物賽跑競技場嗎？

scripts.text: Enter
scripts.translation: 進入

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Alright, then. If you'd like
to wager on a monster
race, please wait for the
current race to finish. I hope
that you enjoy your time here
in the Monster Race Arena~
scripts.translation:
[埃卡爾·艾勒伯德]
好的。
想下注的話，請等這場比賽結束。
希望你在魔物賽跑競技場玩得盡興~

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
Thank you~
I hope you enjoy
watching this race!
scripts.translation:
[埃卡爾·艾勒伯德]
謝謝~
祝你觀賽愉快！

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough money to pay
the 500 zeny spectator fee.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡爾·艾勒伯德]
抱歉，你的錢不夠支付500 Zeny的觀賽費。

scripts.text:
[Eckar Ellebird]
I'm sorry, but a monster
race has just ended, so we're
having the 5 minute period in
which the winners can claim
their Prize Medals. The gate
will open soon, so please wait.
scripts.translation:
[埃卡爾·艾勒伯德]
抱歉，比賽剛結束，現在是5分鐘的領獎時間，獲勝者可以領取神奇的獎牌。
大門很快就會開放，請稍等。

scripts.translation:
[遊戲嚮導]
如果還沒領到免費的賽跑票，就去找票務助手吧。
我剛在你的小地圖上標出了他的位置。

scripts.text:
[Game Guide]
Thank you, and
I hope you enjoy
your time here in the
Monster Racing Arena.
scripts.translation:
[遊戲嚮導]
謝謝，祝你在魔物賽跑競技場玩得開心。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
I'm sorry, but I can't
reward you with any medals
until you make more space
available in your Inventory.
scripts.translation:
[勳章發放員]
抱歉，你得先在物品欄裡騰出些空間，我才能給你發獎牌。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Hello there~
If you've wagered on the
winning monster in a recent
race, then you can exchange
your game ticket here for
some Prize Medals.
scripts.translation:
[勳章發放員]
你好~
如果你押中了剛才那場比賽的獲勝魔物，就可以在這裡憑比賽票兌換神奇的獎牌。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Please remember that you can
only exchange winning Game
Tickets for Prize Medals right
after the race finishes. Prize
Medals may be given to Wayne
in Hugel in exchange for items.
scripts.translation:
[勳章發放員]
記住，只有在比賽剛結束時，才能憑中獎的比賽票兌換神奇的獎牌。
獎牌可以交給毀葛的韋恩，用來兌換物品。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Please remember that you can
only exchange winning Game
Tickets for Prize Medals right
after the race finishes. Prize
Medals may be given to Wayne
in Hugel in exchange for items.
scripts.translation:
[勳章發放員]
記住，只有在比賽剛結束時，才能憑中獎的比賽票兌換神奇的獎牌。
獎牌可以交給毀葛的韋恩，用來兌換物品。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Congratulations! It's really
difficult to guess the winners
of a Dual Monster Race, so you
must be really lucky! Would you
like to exchange your winning
Racing Ticket for Prize Medals?
scripts.translation:
[勳章發放員]
恭喜！
雙魔物賽跑的獲勝魔物可不好猜，你真是太幸運了！
要把中獎的賽跑票兌換成神奇的獎牌嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 好的，請兌換

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Okay, everything looks good,
so here's your Prize Medals~
If you want to trade these
medals for items, please
visit Wayne in Hugel. We hope
you enjoyed the Monster Race~
scripts.translation:
[勳章發放員]
好，一切都沒問題，這是你的神奇的獎牌~
想用獎牌兌換物品，就去找毀葛的韋恩吧。
希望你看魔物賽跑看得開心~

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Um, are you sure? You 
can only exchange a winning
Racing Ticket for Prize Medals
for a short time after the race. If you made a mistake, you
should ask me again quickly.
scripts.translation:
[勳章發放員]
你確定嗎？
中獎的賽跑票只有在比賽結束後的一小段時間內，才能兌換神奇的獎牌。
如果剛才選錯了，就趕緊再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Well, better luck next time...
Although you can't always
be lucky, it's always fun to
wager on the monster races!
scripts.translation:
[勳章發放員]
希望你下次有好運氣...
雖說不可能次次都贏，但給魔物賽跑下注，總是很有趣的！

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
Thanks for visiting the
Monster Race Arena, and
I hope you enjoy your time
here. I'll see you next time~
scripts.translation:
[勳章發放員]
感謝光臨魔物賽跑競技場，祝你在這裡玩得開心。
下次見~

scripts.text:
[Medal Distributor]
You may not have wagered
on the winning monster in
the last race, but I hope that
you get lucky next time~
scripts.translation:
[勳章發放員]
看來你沒押中上一場比賽的獲勝魔物，希望你下次能有好運氣~

scripts.text:
[Exit Guide]
If you have a winning Racing
Ticket, please make sure that
you redeem it for Prize Medals
now. All Racing Tickets become
void once the next race begins.
scripts.translation:
[出口嚮導]
如果你有中獎的賽跑票，務必現在就兌換成神奇的獎牌。
下一場比賽一開始，所有賽跑票都會失效。

scripts.text:
[Exit Guide]
If you wish to leave
the arena, then I can guide
you outside. Would you like
to leave the arena right now?
scripts.translation:
[出口嚮導]
想離開競技場的話，我可以帶你出去。
你現在要離開嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Exit Guide]
Alright, then.
Just let me know
whenever you're
ready to leave.
scripts.translation:
[出口嚮導]
好的。
準備離開時，隨時告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Exit Guide]
Thank you for
your patronage, and
I hope that you come
visit us again soon~
scripts.translation:
[出口嚮導]
感謝惠顧，希望你很快再來玩~

scripts.text:
[Exit Guide]
In accordance with our
policies, I must take your
Racing Ticket before you leave.
Thank you for your patronage,
and I hope you enjoy your time
here in the Monster Race Arena.
scripts.translation:
[出口嚮導]
按照規定，你離開前，我必須收回你的賽跑票。
感謝惠顧，希望你在魔物賽跑競技場玩得開心。

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Curses! We need to deliver
what our customers ordered,
but we've been making nothing
but shipshod products! If we
only had that metal, we could
pump up our product quality!
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
該死！
顧客訂的貨還等著交付，可我們做出來的全是劣質品！
要是有那種金屬，就能提升產品質量了！

scripts.text: What metal are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你說的是哪種金屬

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
There's a small village
at the outskirts of the
Schwarzwald Republic that
gives these special medals
that are made of this metal
which we desperately need...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國邊境有個小村莊，會發放一種特殊獎牌。
那些獎牌就是用我們急需的金屬做的...

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
We've sent one of our best
guildsmen to get some of those
medals for us, but he hasn't
reported back to us quite yet.
I'm getting pretty anxious...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
我們派了一位最出色的公會成員去收集獎牌，可他到現在還沒回來彙報。
我越來越著急了...

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
I mean, we need a whole
lot of that metal to fill out
our orders and finish our
manufacturing research,
but so far, none of us have
been able to get any medals...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
完成訂單和製造研究，都需要大量那種金屬。
可到現在，我們誰都沒弄到獎牌...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh! Are you talking
about the medals that
they give as rewards in
the Monster Race Arena?
I have some of those.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦！
你說的是魔物賽跑競技場發放的獎勵獎牌嗎？
我正好有一些。

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Huh? Show them to me...
Yes! That's exactly what
we need! Would you please
donate your medals so that we
can finally make some quality
products for our customers?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
啊？
給我看看...
沒錯！
這正是我們需要的！
能請你捐出這些獎牌嗎？
有了它們，我們終於能為顧客做出優質產品了！

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
If you happen to obtain any
medals from the Monster
Race Arena in Hugel, then
please bring some of them
to me. I'll be sure to repay
you for your kindness...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
如果你在毀葛的魔物賽跑競技場拿到了獎牌，請帶一些給我。
我一定會報答你的好意...

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Oh, how have you been?
Thank you so much for
donating so many medals,
they've been helpful in my
research. Still, I need more
and more of them everyday...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
哦，最近怎麼樣？
非常感謝你捐了那麼多獎牌，對我的研究幫助很大。
不過，我每天都還需要更多獎牌...

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
The other Blacksmith
Guildsmen are doing their
best to collect Prize Medals
in Hugel, but they keep failing
to win them! If you have any
medals, then may I have some?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
其他鐵匠公會成員都在毀葛努力收集神奇的獎牌，可就是贏不到！
如果你有獎牌，能給我一些嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
If you happen to obtain any
medals from the Monster
Race Arena in Hugel, then
please bring some of them
to me. I'll be sure to repay
you for your kindness...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
如果你在毀葛的魔物賽跑競技場拿到了獎牌，請帶一些給我。
我一定會報答你的好意...

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Goodness, you're carrying
so many things with you!
You'd better put some of
it away in Kafra Storage
before you're overwhelmed
by the bulk of your items!
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
天哪，你帶了這麼多東西！
趕緊把一些東西存到卡普拉倉庫吧，別讓這些物品把你壓垮了！

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Ah, welcome back! I've finally
made a breakthrough in my
metal research! Look, I've
developed this Glittering
Jacket! It's lightweight and
very durable, you see?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
啊，歡迎回來！
我的金屬研究終於有突破了！
看，這是我研發的秘衣 惡德！
又輕便又耐用，看到了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
I wouldn't be able to have
completed this without your
help. Now, would you like to
receive this Glittering Jacket
as my way of repaying you?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
沒有你的幫助，我不可能完成這項研究。
願意收下這件秘衣 惡德，作為我的回報嗎？

scripts.text: Accept
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Wait for Further Development
scripts.translation: 等待後續研發

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Ah, I see. You'd rather wait
until we develop something
more to your liking. In that
case, would you please donate
more medals to my research?
We're always low on them...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
啊，我明白了。
你想等我們研發出更合心意的東西。
那能再捐些獎牌，支援我的研究嗎？
我們總是缺獎牌...

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Oh, you're back!
Thanks to all the medals
that you've donated, I'm now
able to manufacture a set
of slotted armor imbued
with a property of your choice.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
哦，你回來了！
多虧你捐的獎牌，我現在能製造帶插槽的防具了，還可以附上你選擇的屬性。

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
If you'd like, I can repay you
now by creating a set of slotted elemental armor for you, or we
can wait for you to donate more
medals until I can develop
something else for you.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
如果你願意，我現在就能打造帶插槽的屬性防具，作為回報。
你也可以繼續捐獎牌，等我研發出別的東西。

scripts.text: Accept Armor
scripts.translation: 接受防具

scripts.text: Can I have something else?
scripts.translation: 能換點別的嗎

scripts.text: Wait for Further Development
scripts.translation: 等待後續研發

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
I can manufacture one set of
slotted Armor imbued with the
Fire, Earth, Wind, or Water
property. Which property would
you like your armor to have?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
我能製造帶插槽的防具，附上火、地、風或水屬性。
你想要哪種屬性？

scripts.text: Fire Property
scripts.translation: 火屬性

scripts.text: Earth Property
scripts.translation: 地屬性

scripts.text: Wind Property
scripts.translation: 風屬性

scripts.text: Water Property
scripts.translation: 水屬性

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Something else...?
Oh, you must mean
the Glittering Jacket that
I developed earlier. After
all, I have any other items
to offer you for now...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
別的東西...？
哦，你指的應該是我之前研發的秘衣 惡德吧。
畢竟，我現在也沒別的東西可以給你了...

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Ah, I see. You'd rather wait
until we develop something
more to your liking. In that
case, would you please donate
more medals to my research?
We're always low on them...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
啊，我明白了。
你想等我們研發出更合心意的東西。
那能再捐些獎牌，支援我的研究嗎？
我們總是缺獎牌...

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
The other Blacksmith
Guildsmen are doing their
best to collect Prize Medals
in Hugel, but they keep failing
to win them! If you have any
medals, then may I have some?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
其他鐵匠公會成員都在毀葛努力收集神奇的獎牌，可就是贏不到！
如果你有獎牌，能給我一些嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
If you happen to obtain any
medals from the Monster
Race Arena in Hugel, then
please bring some of them
to me. I'll be sure to repay
you for your kindness...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
如果你在毀葛的魔物賽跑競技場拿到了獎牌，請帶一些給我。
我一定會報答你的好意...

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Ah, you're back! I've
extracted all the metal
from the medals you've
given me, and I think I have
enough to create a Level 4
Weapon. Isn't that incredible?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
啊，你回來了！
你給我的獎牌，我已經把其中的金屬都提取出來了。
這些材料應該夠打造一把4級武器了。
是不是很厲害？

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
If you like, I can create
one of these weapons for you
as my way of repaying you for
your help. What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
如果你願意，我可以為你打造其中一把武器，報答你的幫助。
你覺得怎麼樣？

scripts.text: Yes, I want a Level 4 Weapon.
scripts.translation: 我要一把4級武器

scripts.text: Can I have something else?
scripts.translation: 能換點別的嗎

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Something else?
Oh, alright then, would
you like to have a Glittering
Jacket, or a set of slotted
elemental Armor? Please go
ahead and make your choice~
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
想要別的東西？
好吧，那你要秘衣 惡德，還是帶插槽的屬性防具？
選一個吧~

scripts.text: Glittering Jacket
scripts.translation: 秘衣 惡德

scripts.text: Fire Property Armor
scripts.translation: 火屬性防具

scripts.text: Earth Property Armor
scripts.translation: 地屬性防具

scripts.text: Wind Property Armor
scripts.translation: 風屬性防具

scripts.text: Water Property Armor
scripts.translation: 水屬性防具

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
So you'd like to have a
{0}? Please choose
which Level 4 Weapon
that you want me to create.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
你想要{0}，對吧？
請選擇你想讓我打造的4級武器。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 好

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Oh, alright...
Still, I really need
those medals, so if you
change your mind, please
come back as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
哦，好吧...
不過，我真的很需要那些獎牌。
要是改變主意了，請儘快回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Oh, thank you so much!
I can use the metal in those
medals to produce some high
quality products. Now, how
shall I repay you for giving me
some of your Prize Medals?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
哦，太感謝了！
用這些獎牌裡的金屬，我就能做出優質產品了。
你給了我這麼多神奇的獎牌，該怎麼報答你呢？

scripts.text: Base Experience
scripts.translation: 基礎經驗值

scripts.text: Job Experience
scripts.translation: 職業經驗值

scripts.text: No, I'm just glad to help.
scripts.translation: 不用，我很樂意幫忙

scripts.text: How's your research progressing?
scripts.translation: 研究進展如何

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
You just want to improve
yourself, huh? Well, I dunno
if you want to get stronger,
smarter, or faster, but I can
coach you on some visualization if you like. Now, relax with me~
physical development.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
你只是想提升自己，是吧？
嗯，不知道你是想更強壯、更聰明，還是更敏捷，不過我可以指導你做些意象訓練。
現在，跟著我放鬆~
開發身體潛能。

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Focus... and believe.
Believe that you are
becoming what you want
to be! B-believe... with
all of your freakin' heart!
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
集中精神...相信自己。
相信自己正在變成你想成為的樣子！
相...相信...用你整顆心去相信啊！

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
*Phew* How's that?
Now do you see the
power of hope?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
*Phew* 感覺怎麼樣？
現在見識到希望的力量了吧？

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
You want to become more
competent in your job? Um...
Alright, we can do that. Just
meditate with me, and we'll go
do some imagery work together.
I'm real good at this you know.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
你想提升職業能力？
嗯...好吧，這個可以。
跟我一起冥想，我們來做點意象訓練。
這可是我的拿手好戲。

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
J-just... visualize
yourself... being...
t-totally... awesome!
You've gotta see it, and
you've gotta feel it in your
freakin' heart and mind!
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
只...只要...想像自己...變得...超、超厲害！
你得看見那個自己，還得用心、用腦去感受啊！

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Yeap, it doesn't matter
if it's real or imagined...
Your mind will work on
whatever you feed it.
Placebos and psychosomatic symptoms-- it all ties together.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
沒錯，不管是真的，還是想像出來的...
你給大腦什麼資訊，它就會朝那個方向運作。
安慰劑效應、心身症狀——這些都是相通的。

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
What th--?! You sure
you don't want anything?
Hm, well, I think it's kind
of bad karma if I don't give
you anything in return, so...
Think of something. Quick.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
什、什麼？！
你確定什麼都不要？
嗯，受了你的幫助卻不給回報，我怕會遭報應，所以...
趕緊想個想要的東西吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Er, just use the medals
to further your manufacturing
research, and then you can
pay me back if your develop
something new. It's, um, like
an investment in your work!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃，拿這些獎牌繼續你的製造研究吧，等研發出新東西，再報答我就好。
這就，嗯，算是對你研究的一筆投資！

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Yeah... Yeah.
Okay, I see where
you're coming from.
That's pretty smart.
Okay, I'll repay you when
we develop something new!
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
對...對。
好，我明白你的意思了。
真聰明。
那等我們研發出新東西，就報答你！

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Anyway, I need as many
medals as I can get as
soon as I can. How many
medals do you think you
can give me right now?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
總之，我得儘快收集到儘可能多的獎牌。
你現在能給我多少枚？

scripts.text: Take them all.
scripts.translation: 全部給你

scripts.text: How about this much?
scripts.translation: 給這些怎麼樣

scripts.text: No, I changed my mind.
scripts.translation: 不了，我改主意了

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Th-thank you!
Thank you so much!
Your help will greatly
advance my research,
and I promise to repay
you as soon as I can!
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
謝、謝謝！
太感謝你了！
你的幫助會大大推進我的研究，我保證儘快報答你！

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Alright, please enter the
number of medals that
you're willing to give me.
Please don't enter any
number greater than 100.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
好，請輸入你願意捐出的獎牌數量。
不要超過100枚。

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Aw, so you've decided
to cancel? Well, it's your
choice, but I'm still so
disappointed. Please come
back if you change your mind...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
唉，你決定取消了？
好吧，這是你的選擇，可我還是很失望。
如果改變主意了，請再來找我...

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Remember, you can only
enter a number from 1 to 100.
If you want to give me more
medals, then perhaps you
should just give them all to me~
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
記住，只能輸入1到100之間的數字。
如果你想捐更多，不如直接全給我吧~

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
I'm sorry, but I don't
think you have that many
medals with you. Make sure
that you offer me an amount of
medals that you actually have.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
抱歉，你身上好像沒那麼多獎牌。
請按實際擁有的數量來捐。

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Th-thank you!
Thank you so much!
Your help will greatly
advance my research,
and I promise to repay
you as soon as I can!
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
謝、謝謝！
太感謝你了！
你的幫助會大大推進我的研究，我保證儘快報答你！

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Oh, alright...
Still, I really need
those medals, so if you
change your mind, please
come back as soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
哦，好吧...
不過，我真的很需要那些獎牌。
要是改變主意了，請儘快回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Well, I've been able to
create a Glittering Jacket
using the medals that you've
brought to me. But I just know
I can make something better
if you'd bring me more!
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
用你帶來的獎牌，我已經做出了秘衣 惡德。
不過，只要你再帶些獎牌來，我肯定能做出更好的東西！

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
As of now, I have the metal
from ^FF0000{0}^000000 Prizes Medals that
you've donated to me. The more
that you bring, the closer I can get to making a new breakthrough!
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
目前，我已經從你捐贈的^FF0000{0}^000000枚神奇的獎牌中提取了金屬。
你帶來的獎牌越多，我就離新的突破越近！

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Do you really want
this {0}?
You may want to forego this
reward in favor of getting
something better later...
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
你真的想要這件{0}嗎？
也可以先不領取這次的獎勵，留著以後換更好的東西...

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Are you sure that you want
to accept this set of slotted
Fire property Armor? If you do,
I'll need more medals from you
to make further advancements
in my manufacturing research.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
確定要收下這件帶插槽的火屬性防具嗎？
如果收下，我就需要你再捐些獎牌，才能繼續推進製造研究。

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Are you sure that you want
to accept this set of slotted
Earth property Armor? If you do,
I'll need more medals from you

in my manufacturing research.

scripts.translation:

如果收下，我就需要你再捐些獎牌，才能繼續推進製造研究。

scripts.text:

scripts.text:

Are you sure that you want
to accept this set of slotted
I'll need more medals from you
to make further advancements
in my manufacturing research.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
確定要收下這件帶插槽的裝備嗎？
我的製造研究還需要更多獎牌，才能繼續取得進展。

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
So you wish to have a
{0}? If you choose
to have this Level 4 Weapon,
I'll need to melt many of the
medals that you've donated
to me. Shall we proceed?
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
你想要{0}，對吧？
打造這把4級武器，需要熔掉你捐贈的大量獎牌。
要繼續嗎？

scripts.text: Decline
scripts.translation: 拒絕

scripts.text: Accept
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text:
[{0}]
W-wait, I changed my
mind. Would it be fine
if I asked you to give
me a reward later?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等、等等，我改主意了。
能等以後再領獎勵嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Of course, of course.
Remember, if you donate
more medals to me, then
I'll be able to create items
of higher quality for you~
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
當然，當然。
記住，只要你再捐些獎牌，我就能為你做出更優質的物品~

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
I don't think I can develop
anything better than these Level 4 Weapons, but after making
such a big investment, you should decide on what you want carefully.
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
我想我很難研發出比這些4級武器更好的東西了。
不過，你投入了這麼多，還是要仔細考慮想要什麼。

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Here you are, I trust that
this {0} will
serve you well. Thank you
for your help, and I hope that
you'll continue to donate your
medals for my metal research~
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
給你，相信這件{0}一定能派上大用場。
謝謝你的幫助，希望你繼續捐贈獎牌，支援我的金屬研究~

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Great choice! I'm sure
that this set of slotted Fire
property Armor will serve you
well. Thank you for your help,
and if you get more medals,
please donate them to me~
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
選得好！
相信這件帶插槽的火屬性防具一定能派上大用場。
謝謝你的幫助，以後拿到更多獎牌，也請捐給我吧~

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Great choice! I'm sure
that this set of slotted Earth
property Armor will serve you
well. Thank you for your help,
and if you get more medals,
please donate them to me~
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]

Great choice! I'm sure
property Armor will serve you
well. Thank you for your help,
and if you get more medals,
please donate them to me~
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
選得好！
相信這件屬性防具一定能派上大用場。
謝謝你的幫助，以後拿到更多獎牌，也請捐給我吧~

scripts.text:
[Ei'felle]
Once again, I'd like to
thank you for providing
me with all of those medals.
I imagine it must have been
difficult. In any case, I would
appreciate your continued help~
scripts.translation:
[艾菲爾]
再次感謝你給了我那麼多獎牌，想必收集起來很不容易。
希望以後還能得到你的幫助~

scripts.text:
[Wayne]
Hold on a second...
If you want to exchange
your Prize Medals for items,
you'd better free up more space
in your Inventory first. Why don't you use your Kafra Storage?
scripts.translation:
[韋恩]
等一下...
想用神奇的獎牌兌換物品，得先在物品欄裡騰出些空間。
要不先把一些東西存到卡普拉倉庫？

scripts.text:
[Wayne]
Hello, there! Ever wonder
what you could do with all
the Prize Medals you can win
in Monster Race Arena? You
can donate them in Einbroch
to the Blacksmith Guild...
scripts.translation:
[韋恩]
你好！
想過魔物賽跑競技場贏來的神奇的獎牌有什麼用嗎？
你可以把它們捐給艾音布羅克的鐵匠公會...

scripts.text:
[Wayne]
...Or you can exchange them
for items, right here and right
now, with me. As always, the
choice is really up to you.
scripts.translation:
[韋恩]
...也可以現在就找我兌換物品。
當然，怎麼選都由你決定。

scripts.text: Prize Medal Exchange
scripts.translation: 神奇的獎牌兌換

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Wayne]
Well, just keep in mind
that you can always come
to me to trade in your Prize
Medals for consumable items.
That guy in Einbroch? Not sure
what he'd give you for them...
scripts.translation:
[韋恩]
記住，你隨時都能來找我，用神奇的獎牌兌換消耗品。
至於艾音布羅克那個人會給你什麼，我就不清楚了...

scripts.text:
[Wayne]
All I know is that he
needs a whole lot of medals
for the work that he's doing.
Still, I hear that he just may
make your donations worth
all your effort, you know?
scripts.translation:
[韋恩]
我只知道，他的研究需要大量獎牌。
不過，聽說他給的回報，會讓你覺得付出的努力都值得呢。

scripts.text:
[Wayne]
Hold on a second...
If you want to exchange
your Prize Medals for items,
you'd better free up more space
in your Inventory first. Why don't you use your Kafra Storage?
scripts.translation:
[韋恩]
等一下...
想用神奇的獎牌兌換物品，得先在物品欄裡騰出些空間。
要不先把一些東西存到卡普拉倉庫？

scripts.text:
[Wayne]
Now, how many Prize Medals
would you like to exchange?
It doesn't take a genius to
figure out that you can get
more valuable items by trading
more Prize Medals at a time.
scripts.translation:
[韋恩]
你想用多少枚神奇的獎牌來兌換？
不用多想也知道，一次拿出的獎牌越多，能換到的物品就越值錢。

placeholders: ((getarraysize(.@item_array)<3)?" Well, we have only 1 set, but...":"")
scripts.text:
[Wayne]
Now, please choose
which of the following item
sets that you'd like to receive
in exchange for {0} Prize Medal.{1}
scripts.translation:
[韋恩]
請從下面幾組物品中選一組，用{0}枚神奇的獎牌兌換。{1}

scripts.text:
[Wayne]
Hey, you don't have
enough Prize Medals with
you. Go and get some more
if you want to exchange
them with me for anything.
scripts.translation:
[韋恩]
嘿，你的神奇的獎牌不夠。
想找我兌換物品，就先去多弄些獎牌吧。

scripts.text:
[Wayne]
There you go~
Thanks for using my
service, and I hope that
you come visit me again
soon. Enjoy the monster
races, fair adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[韋恩]
給你~
感謝使用我的服務，希望你很快再來。
祝你玩魔物賽跑玩得開心，勇敢的冒險者~

scripts.text:
[Eocatt]
There's an old, humble
village on the outskirts of
the Schwarzwald Republic.
It was just a tiny blip on the
map until they opened up
their Monster Race Arena!
scripts.translation:
[埃奧卡特]
修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國邊境有個古老、樸素的小村莊。
以前它在地圖上毫不起眼，直到魔物賽跑競技場開張，才出了名！

scripts.text:
[Eocatt]
If you win wagers on the
monster race games, you'll
be rewarded with these Prize
Medals that are made of some
really rare metal. I hear this metal's in demand in Einbroch...
scripts.translation:
[埃奧卡特]
押中魔物賽跑的獲勝魔物，就能得到神奇的獎牌。
這些獎牌是用一種非常稀有的金屬做的，聽說艾音布羅克很需要這種金屬...

scripts.text:
[Eocatt]
Right, right...
I remember now, the
town was named Hugel.
I'm sure there's other fun
things to do there, but I'm sure that the Race Arena is a must!
scripts.translation:
[埃奧卡特]
對了，對了...
我想起來了，那地方叫毀葛。
那裡應該還有別的好玩的，不過賽跑競技場絕對不能錯過！

scripts.text:
[Mudie]
The Monster Races
are probably the biggest
attraction here in Hugel.
We don't have much else
going on here, I'm afraid.
scripts.translation:
[穆迪]
魔物賽跑大概是毀葛最受歡迎的活動了。
我們這裡恐怕也沒多少別的熱鬧可看。

scripts.text:
[Mudie]
If you want to go visit
the Monster Race Arena,
just head towards the
7 'o clock direction on
your Mini-Map, and look for
the hill surrounded by a fence.
scripts.translation:
[穆迪]
想去魔物賽跑競技場，就朝小地圖的7點鐘方向走，找一座圍著柵欄的小山丘。

scripts.text:
[Mudie]
You should find the arena
somewhere around that area.
Anyway, if you want to wager
or just watch the races, just
ask one of the Eckar brothers. I hope you enjoy our little town~
scripts.translation:
[穆迪]
競技場就在那一帶。
想下注或只是看比賽，找埃卡爾兄弟中的任何一位都行。
希望你喜歡我們的小鎮~

scripts.text:
[Eccentric Scholar]
Let's see now...
Monster 1's average speed
and luck, as affected by
wind resistance, fatigue...
What's the approximate
probability of winning...?
scripts.translation:
[古怪的學者]
讓我看看...
1號魔物的平均速度、幸運值，再考慮風阻、疲勞的影響...
獲勝的機率大概是多少...？

scripts.text:
[Eccentric Scholar]
Crunch it into my
algorithm... Carry the two...
Wait, how many significant
figures should I be using?
Ah, right, 7, to account for x,
a value representing--
scripts.translation:
[古怪的學者]
代入我的演算法...進2...
等等，該保留幾位有效數字？
啊，對，7位，還得考慮x，這個值代表——

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, but
what are you doing?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下，你在做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Eccentric Scholar]
S-silence!
I must complete
my calculations!
Now, where was I...?
scripts.translation:
[古怪的學者]
安、安靜！
我必須算完！
剛才算到哪兒了...？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
How many times must
I wager on these races?!
I haven't won even once!
Oh, I must have the worst
luck in wagering history!
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠公會成員]
到底還要下多少次注啊？！
我一次都沒贏過！
我一定是下注史上最倒霉的人！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
I've been assigned by my
guild to bring back some
Prize Medals to Einbroch...
They're apparently made
with some rare metal, but...
It's too hard for me to win~!
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠公會成員]
公會派我來，要我帶些神奇的獎牌回艾音布羅克...
聽說獎牌是用某種稀有金屬做的，可是...
要贏到獎牌也太難了~！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
Run! Go go go!
I need to win some
medals! Otherwise, I'll
be too ashamed to return
home to Einbroch! F-faster!
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠公會成員]
跑啊！
快跑快跑！
我得贏些獎牌才行，不然哪有臉回艾音布羅克！
再、再快點！

scripts.text:
[Valiant Knight]
Hey, have you been
wagering on the races?
If you've got a hot tip, then
would you share it with me?
I've won some wagers... But
I really wanna win more!
scripts.translation:
[英勇的騎士]
嘿，你也在給比賽下注嗎？
有什麼可靠訊息，能告訴我嗎？
我已經贏了幾次...不過，還想贏更多！

scripts.text:
[Valiant Knight]
Hah hah! It's like I tell
those Blacksmiths! If they
don't wanna lose all the time,
then they should just bet on the same monster. Me? I always
bet on the black Deviruchi~
scripts.translation:
[英勇的騎士]
Hah hah! 我早就跟那些鐵匠說過！
不想一直輸，就該一直押同一只魔物。
我？
我總是押黑色的小惡魔~

scripts.text:
[Valiant Knight]
You too...!
Always bet
on Deviruchi!
scripts.translation:
[英勇的騎士]
你也一樣...！
就一直押小惡魔！

scripts.text:
[Familiar Drunkard]
Grrr...! ^333333*Hiccup*^000000
I just gotta win this
next game! I hafta do it!
Hey, you! Which number is
your lucky number? Huh?
scripts.translation:
[眼熟的酒鬼]
Grrr...! ^333333*Hiccup*^000000
下一場我一定得贏！
一定得贏！
嘿，你！
你的幸運數字是幾？
啊？

scripts.text:
[Familiar Drunkard]
C'mon, I need your
lucky number cuz I ran
out of mine! Tell me!
Tell me! ^333333*Hiccup~*^000000
scripts.translation:
[眼熟的酒鬼]
快說，我的幸運數字都用光了，得借你的用用！
告訴我！
告訴我！^333333*Hiccup~*^000000

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
How can this be so hard?
Why can't I win at least
one of these races? Argh!
I can't go back until I get
at least one Prize Medal!
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠公會成員]
怎麼會這麼難？
為什麼我連一場都贏不了？
Argh! 不拿到至少一枚神奇的獎牌，我就不能回去！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
Yeah, I've been assigned
by the Einbroch Factory to
get some Prize Medals since
they're made of this rare medal. But it looks like they picked
the wrong guy for this job...
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠公會成員]
是啊，艾音布羅克工廠派我來收集神奇的獎牌，因為獎牌是用稀有金屬做的。
可看來他們找錯人了...

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
I mean, I've been here
forever and I haven't won
anything yet! Hey, do me
a favor and give any extra
Prize Medals you might have
to the Einbroch Factory, okay?
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠公會成員]
我在這兒待了那麼久，什麼都沒贏到！

Say, are you here to bet
on the monster races? I've
come all the way here, just
because some strange man
asked me to win medals. It's
the only reason I'm in Hugel...

[心不在焉的男子]
你也是來給魔物賽跑下注的嗎？
有個奇怪的男人叫我來贏獎牌，我才大老遠跑到這裡。
我來毀葛，就為了這件事...

scripts.text:
[Absent Minded Man]
But I've made more than
100 wagers, and haven't won
any of them! I mean, if I bet
on the same monster 6 times,
I should win at least once,
right? What's going on?!
scripts.translation:
[心不在焉的男子]
可我下了100多次注，一次都沒贏！
同一只魔物押6次，怎麼也該贏一次吧？
到底怎麼回事？！
